summary_en: City Index Fifth Co., Ltd. commenced a tender offer for all investment units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (TSE Code: 2972) at 125,000 yen per unit, with a planned acquisition of 375,636 units (minimum acceptance of 118,732 units) during a 30-business-day period from September 28 to November 10, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Investment Units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (TSE Code: 2972) by City Index Fifth Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
City Index Fifth Co., Ltd. announced the commencement of a tender offer for investment units of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (TSE Code: 2972) on September 25, 2026. The offeror will acquire up to 375,636 units at a fixed price of 125,000 yen per unit, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 118,732 units. The tender offer period runs for 30 business days from September 28 to November 10, 2026.

The disclosure does not provide the total number of outstanding units (excluding self-held units) needed to calculate the percentage of outstanding units, nor does it specify the motivation for the tender offer, any premium relative to closing price, board recommendations, or conditions such as regulatory approval. The offeror is City Index Fifth Co., Ltd., and the target is Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation, a REIT listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
